about.description: Learn more about WPY — background, skills, and how to get in touch.
about.aboutMeDesc: A bit about my background and what I do.
about.background1: Hello, and welcome to my tech space. I am an Android developer with 6 years of hands-on experience. Throughout my career, I have immersed myself in mobile development, building a solid engineering foundation in complex business architecture design, memory and performance optimization, and high-concurrency processing. Yet the beauty of technology lies in breaking boundaries — with the rise of large language models, I chose to step out of my comfort zone, integrating AI capabilities into my daily development workflow and successfully making the leap to full-stack development.
about.background2: Years of mobile development experience have sharpened my sensitivity to user experience and on-device performance, while my full-stack and AI learning journey have equipped me with a complete end-to-end capability — from underlying data and cloud architecture to frontend interactions. Today, I habitually leverage AI to accelerate code generation and testing, apply mobile-grade rigor to designing web systems, and let data drive every product iteration.
about.background3: This blog is my personal open-source digital garden. Here, I openly share real-world pitfall records from daily development and my transition journey, showcase full-stack and AI projects I have built with my own hands, and distill the technical insights behind the code and architecture. I believe that great engineers should not be defined by a single language or platform. I hope these authentic experiences can offer you some inspiration, and I look forward to being creative engineers together with you in the age of AI.
